description: This file defines the LeaveEventSubscriber class, which subscribes to various leave-related events in the OrangeHRM system. It handles event-driven email notifications for leave applications, approvals, cancellations, rejections, and assignments by processing specific leave events and utilizing an email service.

classes.name: LeaveEventSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling leave-related events and sending email notifications accordingly, utilizing the email service and reacting to leave application, approval, cancellation, rejection, and assignment events.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping leave events to corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailService instance used to queue email notifications.

methods.name: onAllocateEvent
methods.description: Handles leave allocation events (apply or assign) and queues email notifications based on event type.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles leave status change events (approve, cancel, reject) and queues email notifications accordingly.
